checks: Independent re-derivation (team/checks/chk_q26.py): Xb4b spw25/27 pbcor cubes, own code, native beam, +-350 km/s about 2780 km/s (each line on its own velocity axis), per-pixel median baseline from 700-1100 km/s off-line channels, aperture at the HCO+ m0 peak, T_b ratio = Jy ratio x (nu_HCO+/nu_HCN)^2. Result: N 1.08 (r=0.26'') / 0.98 (r=0.52''), S 0.46 / 0.42. Matches the worker's N 0.99-1.0, S 0.43-0.48 within the estimator spread the worker quotes (0.03-0.1). Different beams per line in my check, so I do not claim better than ~0.08.

Confirmed the ~117 km/s offset between the HCN (spw27) and HCO+ (spw25) velocity axes (first channel 3353 vs 3471 km/s with the same convention). The worker's regridding fix is needed for the wing/bin ratios, and the moment-0 ratios are insensitive to it, as stated. Agree.

Forum consistency: team-a p0004/p0003-r01 (N 0.83-0.90, S 0.40-0.41 at 1.05''), p0005-r02/r05 (N 0.98-1.0 inward rise at 0.3'', S flat 0.37-0.42, Xb4b vs Xb4d agree 2-4%) and p0010/p0005-r03 (no N wing rise at 0.3'', mixing at 1'') all agree with the worker's tables, including alpha(N) = -0.23 and the beam-mixing explanation for the 250-pc red rise. The N/S contrast 2.1 (3-2) vs 1.5 (1-0, Harada via team-a p0007-r01) is quoted and not left in conflict.

Significance is calibrated correctly: N/S contrast is stat->40 sigma, flux scale cancels, estimator spread (1.9-2.3) is the real error, baseline test <1%, cross-array (Xb4b/Xb4d at 250 pc, Xb4d/Xb4f at 6.5'') agreement <=0.04. Beam-matching conventions (common 0.26'' circular beam for both lines, flux-conserving convolution, 194 pc/'' stated as an assumption) are standard. Agree with the conclusion that the contrast is not a beam-dilution artefact and is a HCN-only contrast at equal HCO+ T_b.
Weaker parts, correctly flagged by the worker: E1/E2 array dependence (+-0.15), W, Bridge wings. The lobe/ridge ratios (>=1) are 4-6 sigma in HCO+ for Xb4b and depend on array (0.96 vs 1.43).
notes_for_questioner: Wording to keep in the report/post: (1) The S blue lobe / red ridge ratio >=1 is tentative. Team-a p0024/p0006-r03 find the same HCN excess only at 3.2 sigma global after trials and cannot exclude blends (HDO, CH3NH2, etc.); the window used here (-320..-180, +180..+320) contains the HCN v2=1f / blend region at +401 only marginally but a blend test (excess over k*HCO+) was not repeated. Say 'tentative, blend not excluded' and do not call it a dense-gas detection. (2) The ratio is a T_b ratio of RJ moment-0, not a column ratio. 14% flux scale is outside the quoted errors, fine for contrast. (3) Physical follow-up that this opens: the N ratio rising inward (alpha -0.23) while S is flat implies a compact (<=50 pc) HCN-bright component at N. Fit a core+envelope decomposition of the N ratio vs beam (core ratio ~1.0 plus envelope ~0.4 like S/Bridge) to get the core flux fraction and size, then feed the 50-pc T_b (HCO+ equal at N and S, HCN 2x lower at S) into the Q27 RADEX/filling grid as a pair of T_b constraints: equal HCO+ and unequal HCN at equal HCO+ is the discriminator for column/abundance vs excitation, and 1-0 data (Harada) fix part of it. (4) Xb4b resolves out extended flux, so the 50-pc E1/E2/Bridge ratios have an unknown short-spacing bias; quote Xb4d-matched values where HCN is faint. (5) HCN zero level (team-a factor ~4 in wings) and continuum-proportional baseline were not tested; matters only for wing bins.
